card.name: Spaces and small words before a continuation
card.fires_on: Mostly a space or a short linking word (and, in, us, much, consult) in running text, just before the text continues with a new item or phrase. It also fires on odd spots inside a word such as TOXIC.

modes.label: Space after comma in drug lists
modes.description: A blank space token between listed drug components, right before the next drug name.

modes.label: Short linking word mid-sentence
modes.description: Small words like and, in or consult that sit between two parts of a phrase in general prose or label text.

modes.label: Inside a capitalized medical term
modes.description: A letter piece partway through an all-caps term in a boxed warning.

card.writes: It promotes whitespace tokens and suppresses odd symbols, so it adds little beyond favoring plain spacing.
card.plain: It fires on small spaces and linking words in the middle of a sentence, where the next word is expected to follow.
